final_message: Implemented cross-process concurrency for exec run (plan C): `exec run --register --worktree --join` joins a running shareable register worktree run through join slots limited by `run.max_concurrent_runs` (default 4). Provider `max_concurrency`, the register lifecycle (start transition, checkpoint, merge, wait commit, view rebuild) and parent validations are coordinated across processes via heartbeat slot locks in `src/exec-slot-lock.ts`. Default `--if-busy` behaviour and routine skip are unchanged. Added `exec slots` to show limits and usage, the schema key, unit tests, guide/reference updates, and the ticket's work table and results. None of the new tests has been run yet; parent-run test-unit and typecheck will be their first execution. A real two-process integration test is not written and is left as a `_TODO_` in the ticket.
